## `neuro.uint8ClampedArray.with`

Instance method on `Uint8ClampedArray.prototype`.

> Copies the array and inserts the given number at the provided index.

## Signatures

```ts
with(input: { uint8ClampedArray: <receiver>; index: number; value: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<Uint8ClampedArray>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.with` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
